audit.why: 42.11% over 57 games with Vayne owning levels 2-3 and everything from 6 onward. The prose already concedes the late 1v1 outright, which matches both the chart and the win rate.
Akshan's Lvl 2-3 window, Vayne's Lvl 6 Final Hour, the colliding first-item spikes, and her late true-damage scaling. Correctly placed on both sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry claims twice that Vayne 'breaks your W camo' — in spikes[1] ('breaks your W camo on contact') and again in mid and whys[4]. Nothing in Vayne's kit reveals or detects. Final Hour grants HER invisibility during Tumble; it does not strip Going Rogue's camouflage. Separately, Silver Bolts is described as stacking off hits only, when abilities count toward the third stack too.
audit.why: Riot's text for Final Hour: 'gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter.' No reveal, no detection. Riot's text for Silver Bolts: 'The third consecutive attack OR ABILITY against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.' A fabricated counter to the reader's own escape and roam tool is the worst kind of error here — it tells an Akshan player his W is useless in a lane where the W roam is the actual win condition the same entry recommends.
audit.corrected: Final Hour shortens Tumble and makes it a stealth; it does not reveal you, so Going Rogue camouflage still works against her. Silver Bolts stacks on autos AND abilities, and the payoff is percent-max-health true damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Condemn is discussed four times with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Condemn is 20/18/16/14/12s — the longest cooldown in her kit by a wide margin. A whiffed Condemn at rank 1 is a 20-second window where she has no disengage from a Heroic Swing, and that is the concrete trade cue the page lacked.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Tumble auto-reset tell is absent.
audit.why: Tumble is an auto-attack reset on a 6s rank-1 cooldown, so her burst opens with the tumble rather than with a visible ability cast. The tumble animation, not the shot, is the cue to disengage.

edits.before: Vayne is one of the few ranged champs you can actually bully early, because at level 1 she has no waveclear, no Silver Bolts stacks worth fearing, and only her Q tumble to reposition. Hit your level 2-3 spike hard: throw Q for the poke, walk up for a double-shot passive proc, and back off before she can tumble-reset her autos onto you. The thing to dodge is her E condemn — if you E-swing past her toward a wall she'll knock you against it and stun you, so swing in open ground. Punish her now, because this is the only phase the matchup is in your favor.
edits.after: Vayne is one of the few ranged champs you can actually bully early, because at level 1 she has no waveclear, no Silver Bolts stacks worth fearing, and only Tumble to reposition. Hit your level 2-3 spike hard: throw Q for the poke, walk up for a double-shot passive proc, then leave — her burst opens with a Tumble auto-reset, so the tumble itself is your cue to step off, not the shot that follows. Dodge Condemn (E), 550 range on a 20s cooldown: swing in open ground, because a wall behind you turns that knockback into a stun.

edits.before: Once Vayne hits 6 and lands a crit item, the lane flips. Final Hour buffs her and turns her Q tumble into a stealth, so she vanishes from your single-target R lock-on and breaks your W camo the moment she's revealed near you — your execute becomes a coin-flip instead of a guaranteed pick. Her W Silver Bolts deal percent-max-HP true damage every third hit, which ignores your shieldless squishy frame entirely — armor does nothing. Use your level 4-5 Q and E poke to keep chipping while you still out-range her item-less form, but the second she has that first crit item, stop trying to all-in. Take your W camo and roam — your lead has to come from the map, not this lane.
edits.after: Once Vayne hits 6 and lands a crit item, the lane flips. Final Hour buffs her, shortens Tumble and turns it into a stealth, so she vanishes from your single-target R lock-on — your execute becomes a coin-flip instead of a guaranteed pick. Silver Bolts deals percent-max-HP true damage on every third hit and abilities count toward the stack, so armour does nothing for your frame. Keep chipping with level 4-5 Q and E poke while you still out-range her item-less form, and punish Condemn: 20s at rank 1 means one whiff buys you a free trade. Once that crit item lands, stop all-inning — take W camo and roam, because she cannot reveal it.

edits.after: At 6 Final Hour buffs her and stealths Tumble on a shorter cooldown — she slips your R lock while Silver Bolts' true damage bites, so her skirmish power now outgrows your pick threat.

edits.before: Her W percent-HP true damage shreds your squishy frame through any armor and her Final Hour stealth makes your missing-health R execute nearly unlandable.
edits.after: Silver Bolts' percent-HP true damage shreds you through any armour, and stealthed Tumbles under Final Hour make your missing-health R execute nearly unlandable.

notes: The entry twice told the reader that Vayne breaks Going Rogue's camouflage. She has no reveal or detection anywhere in her kit — Final Hour makes HER invisible during Tumble. That fabrication matters because the same entry's stated win condition is 'take your W camo and roam', which the false claim tells the player not to bother with. Removed it in all three places and turned it into a positive: camouflage still works against her. Also added that Silver Bolts stacks off abilities as well as autos, Condemn's 20s rank-1 cooldown as the trade cue, and the Tumble auto-reset burst tell from the _missing file.
